bulletins.title: UK Fake Airline Compensation / Flight Disruption Scams
bulletins.summary: UK Take Five to Stop Fraud warns that criminals impersonate airlines on social media after flight disruptions, offering fake compensation or refunds and steering victims into private chats that harvest bank details or push money transfers. Contact airlines only through official channels — never via unsolicited DMs — and report fraud at reportfraud.police.uk.

bulletins.title: Sextortion Extortion Campaign Impersonating Hacking Groups
bulletins.summary: Scammers are sending extortion messages citing leaked personal data and claiming to be from the ShinyHunters hacking group. The messages allege that malware was installed on the victim's phone and camera to record private footage, demanding $2,000 in Bitcoin under threat of broadcasting it to contacts.
phrases: We are the ShinyHunters hacking group
installed an exploit on your devices
access to your microphone camera keyboard
created videos of you pleasuring yourself
share these videos with your friends
remove the malware from your devices

bulletins.title: AI Voice Cloning and Spoofed Bank Impersonation Calls
bulletins.summary: Scammers are leveraging AI voice cloning alongside caller ID spoofing to impersonate financial institutions during live calls and robocalls. Callers reference personal data gathered from data breaches to convince victims to verify account credentials or transfer funds.
phrases: transfer funds to a safe account

add_phrases: We are the ShinyHunters hacking group

gemini_context_snippet: This week's active consumer scam campaigns focus on sextortion extortion emails leveraging leaked breach data to demand Bitcoin payments, as well as AI-powered robocalls using caller ID spoofing and voice cloning to impersonate banks and request urgent credential verification. Also active: UK Take Five warning on fake airline compensation / flight-disruption refund DMs that harvest bank details.
